questions.text: A man bought 16 articles at ₹85 each, 15 at ₹65 each, and 12 at ₹75 each. What is the average price of each article? (Up to two places of decimal)
The difference (in ₹, to the nearest integer) between the simple interest and the compound interest on ₹3,660 for one and a half years at 10% per annum, compounded half-yearly, is:
Rama’s marks in two subjects, mathematics and physics, are in the ratio 8∶ 13. If he got 25 marks more in physics than in mathematics, what are his marks in mathematics?
The product of two numbers is 2028 and their HCF is 13. Find their LCM.
A garrison of 1200 men has provisions for 15 days. How long will the provisions last if the garrison is increased by 600 men?

What must be the total percentage change (rounded off to 1 decimal place) in the volume of a cuboid if its length and breadth are increased by 24% and 45%, respectively, while its height is decreased by 55%?

Kumar invested a total of ₹16,900 partly in two schemes, A and B. The rate of simple interest in the two schemes were 14% p.a. and 11% p.a., respectively. If the total interest earned in 2 years was ₹4,498, then what was the amount invested in Scheme B?

An item was sold at a profit of 23.75%. If the cost price of the item was ₹1,000 more than what it actually was, while the selling price remained unchanged, the profit earned would have been only 10%. What was the actual cost price of the item (in ₹)?
Rewa misread the number 45 as 54. Find the percentage increase or decrease in this process.
A shopkeeper sells an article for ₹360 after allowing a discount of 10%. What would have been its selling price (in ₹) had he offered a discount of 20%?

A policeman chases a thief who is at a distance of 450 metres from him. The thief starts running at a speed of 9 km/h, the moment he sees the policeman. The policeman gives chase immediately with a speed of 12 km/h. Eventually, the thief is caught. What is the distance (in km) run by the thief?
